d: Jet black, wavy hair falls to the shoulders with long bangs swept to the side, framing a youthful, mature face with narrow, sharp blue eyes behind rectangular glasses. A slender build is dressed in a beige cable-knit turtleneck sweater, a dark brown belt at the waist, and black thigh-high stockings held by garter straps. Over this, a long white lab coat with pink accents, black straps, and wide cuffs is worn open, while a blue glowing energy sphere floats above one hand.
